name: Trolley Dash
detailed_description:
Welcome to Trolley Dash, the frantic endless arcade shopping game where speed, precision, and quick decision-making are key! As a top-down isometric shopper, your goal is simple but relentless: grab the correct items for incoming orders, sort them into your baskets, and deliver them to the checkout—before time runs out!

Sounds easy? Think again! Moving obstacles, rogue trolleys, and shifting store layouts will keep you on your toes. The challenge never stops, and every second counts in your pursuit of the highest score! How long can you keep up the dash before the supermarket chaos overwhelms you?

Key Features:

🛒 Endless, Fast-Paced Gameplay – Orders keep coming, and it’s up to you to keep up! There’s no finish line—only the high score.
🏃 Dodge & Weave Through Obstacles – Avoid rogue trolleys, navigate moving and rotating shelves, and plan your route efficiently!
🎯 Two-Basket System – Manage your baskets strategically to grab and deliver orders efficiently.
⏳ Race Against the Clock – The faster you fulfill orders, the more points you earn. But if you take too long, it’s game over!
📈 Global & Local Leaderboards – Compete against friends and players worldwide to claim the title of the ultimate trolley dasher!
🎨 Vibrant Isometric Art Style – A colorful, stylized supermarket full of life, movement, and just the right amount of chaos.

Design:

Trolley Dash captures the thrill of classic arcade score-chasing, blending tight controls, fast decision-making, and lighthearted chaos into an addictive gameplay loop. Easy to learn, but tough to master, every run is a new chance to climb the leaderboards.

Do you have the reflexes and strategy to become the #1 shopper? Grab your trolley and prove it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7530U / Intel Core i3-10100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Graphics (integrated) / Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-10400

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
